branch.name: branch
branch.description: Start new work: create <name> from origin's default branch (just fetched), carrying uncommitted changes.

cfs:curl.name: cfs:curl
cfs:curl.description: Call a CloudFront Signer (Midway) protected URL: cfs:curl [--json] [-i] GET https://dxxxx.cloudfront.net/path [body]

cfs:onboard.name: cfs:onboard
cfs:onboard.description: Onboard the edge distribution at CloudFrontSigner (Midway; after the first edge deploy, and again after the edge is renamed or recreated). --status | --offboard

check:generated.name: check:generated
check:generated.description: CI only: fail when the committed generated files (pipeline, cre-stacks.json, ...) are not what npx projen makes

check:stack-plan.name: check:stack-plan
check:stack-plan.description: Fail if the synthesized stacks differ from the committed cre-stacks.json (names, environments, parameters, outputs, jobs)

check:stack-wiring.name: check:stack-wiring
check:stack-wiring.description: Fail if any synthesized stack uses a CloudFormation export/import or crossRegionReferences (pass outputs -> parameters instead)

ci:rerun.name: ci:rerun
ci:rerun.description: Retry the failed jobs of the deploy of main's head; --all runs the whole deploy again. Then: npx projen watch --sha <sha>.

commit.name: commit
commit.description: Validate (synth + build), stage and commit. Never pushes. Needs --message.

deploy.name: deploy
deploy.description: Run the deploy pipeline locally (builds first): deploy:upload, deploy:stack per stack in order, deploy:prune. [--stack id] [--no-build] [--profile p]

deploy:prune.name: deploy:prune
deploy:prune.description: Internal CI job step (use npx projen deploy): Remove old deploy prefixes from every region bucket (keeps current + 2).

deploy:s3.name: deploy:s3
deploy:s3.description: Internal CI job step (use npx projen deploy): Make every listed region's assets bucket if missing, and sync dist/content.zip's contents to it.

steps.say: No stacks in the app yet: nothing to upload.

deploy:stack.name: deploy:stack
deploy:stack.description: Internal CI job step (use npx projen deploy): Deploy one stack with the variables its pipeline job sets (see cre-stacks.json `jobs`).

deploy:upload.name: deploy:upload
deploy:upload.description: Internal CI job step (use npx projen deploy): Publish build artifacts: S3 content, and container images with containerImages.

git:status.name: git:status
git:status.description: Classify the repo state and say what `push` would do. Changes nothing (it only fetches).

install.name: install
install.description: Install project dependencies and update lockfile (non-frozen)

install:ci.name: install:ci
install:ci.description: Install project dependencies using frozen lockfile

package.name: package
package.description: Stage CFN assets and zip into dist/content.zip

package:assets.name: package:assets
package:assets.description: Stage every stack's assets into assets/ and rewrite nested templates

package:content.name: package:content
package:content.description: Build dist/content.zip — the artifact the deploy stage consumes

steps.exec: mkdir -p dist assets && cd assets && if [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then zip -r ../dist/content.zip .; else python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('../dist/content.zip', 'w').close()"; fi
rm -rf assets cdk.out && mkdir -p assets dist

push.name: push
push.description: Validate, commit, push, open/update the MR/PR and arm auto-merge. Needs --message; --branch when a new branch is needed.

setup:aws.name: setup:aws
setup:aws.description: The CI runner role and the CloudFormation execution role in the deploy account, and with --dns-profile the DNS roles in the hosted zone's account, as CloudFormation stacks (idempotent: an unchanged stack is a no-op).

setup:github-app.name: setup:github-app
setup:github-app.description: Create (once) or check your CRE automation GitHub App, aws-cre-automation-<alias>, and its key in ~/.cre.

setup:github-public.name: setup:github-public
setup:github-public.description: A private repo made public, end to end (from a clean main): scan the history for credentials (--dry-run stops there), make it public with the AWS environment, move the deploy trust and role secrets to that environment, then set github.visibility in .projenrc.ts and merge the regenerated workflows as a PR.

setup:repo.name: setup:repo
setup:repo.description: Re-apply the GitHub repo's settings and set the CI/CD variables given (idempotent: only what differs changes). A variable that feeds a noEcho parameter is stored hidden.

skills:doctor.name: skills:doctor
skills:doctor.description: Check that the vended agent skills (.kiro/skills/* symlinks into cre-demo-template) resolve.

stacks.name: stacks
stacks.description: Each planned stack's deployed status, plus orphans (this project's stacks that main's committed plan no longer has). [--profile p]

stacks:outputs.name: stacks:outputs
stacks:outputs.description: The deployed stacks' outputs (URLs, ids) as `<stack> <Key>=<Value>`. [--stack id] [--profile p]

synth.name: synth
synth.description: Synthesizes your cdk app into cdk.out

synth:silent.name: synth:silent
synth:silent.description: Synthesizes your cdk app into cdk.out and suppresses the template in stdout (part of "yarn build")

teardown.name: teardown
teardown.description: Delete the stacks in reverse deploy order. Running it deletes; --dry-run only lists them, so run that first. [--orphans] [--stack id] [--profile p]

update-template.name: update-template
update-template.description: Pull the cre-demo-template clone, refresh projenrc/cre, cre-constructs and the skill links from it, then synth + build.

watch.name: watch
watch.description: Read-only: follow an MR/PR from its checks through the merge to the deploy of its merge commit. [<n>|--branch b|--sha s] [--until checks|merged|deployed]
